change: data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/holdings_snapshot.py: redistribute_holdouts() (THE DIFFERENCE CONTROL, called from run_firm for every firm) previously built its isolated 'wrong' copy via `json.loads(json.dumps(snapshot))` -- a full deep-copy of every node (SLEEVE/MODEL_LEAF/SECURITY/CASH included), even though this function, holdouts_held(), and run_firm()'s difference_control block only ever read back ACCOUNT-kind node_id/node_kind/amount plus the small attribution_holdouts and custody_totals blocks (verified by reading every use site and by test_holdouts.py, which asserts only on ACCOUNT-kind nodes and the _redistributed aggregate). Replaced the full deep-copy with a copy of exactly what is read/mutated: a list of ACCOUNT-kind {node_id, node_kind, amount} dicts, a copy.deepcopy of attribution_holdouts (the only mutated block), and a bare reference to custody_totals (read-only, never mutated in this function). Same formulas, same branches, same field names and values on the returned object -- only the population copied narrowed to what downstream code touches. Added `import copy` (stdlib) to the same file. holdings_snapshot.py is shared by all three firms and is also a member of the directory chain's separate `investor-reporting.tar.gz` bundle (per the order's own note) -- this change does not touch that bundle (never re-minted here) and does not change output for INF/COT (same narrowing logic; INF/COT were not profiled here but the function's read/write contract is identical for every firm). holdings_49f.py itself is unchanged.

pytest_summary: 7 failed, 270 passed, 7 errors in 19.05s (python -m pytest data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/tests -q) -- the 7 failures + 7 errors are ALL in test_holdings_inf.py/test_inf_positions.py on ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'lib.silver_ids', a pre-existing test-isolation defect unrelated to this change (git diff --stat for this session touches only holdings_snapshot.py; the same INF tests pass 12/12 when test_holdings_inf.py is run alone). Root cause measured and filed as a surprise row, not fixed here (out of this order's <paths> grant): test_bundle_manifest_stamp.py permanently inserts .tools onto sys.path (never pops it) to import .tools/safe_deploy_core; .tools/lib/ is itself a real package (tooling helper, e.g. project_registry.py) distinct from the repo-root lib/ package (silver_ids.py, opal_naming.py, etc.) that _orion_api_silver_lib.py needs -- once anything imports bare `lib` while .tools sits ahead of the repo root on sys.path, Python caches sys.modules['lib'] pointing at .tools/lib/, and every later `from lib.silver_ids import ...` in the same process fails with ModuleNotFoundError regardless of a correct later sys.path.insert, because Python resolves an already-imported package's submodules from its cached __path__, not by re-walking sys.path.
result: peak_rss_mb dropped from 2151.9 to 1553.8 (-598.1 MB, -27.8%), under the 2,000 MB target.
